Scoring Methodology

How opportunity is calculated

Transparent weights
Demand Fit

Demographic attractiveness score using population size, density, age 18–34, student-age proxy, renters/apartments, income, and employment indicators.

Competition Pressure

Market crowding score using total gyms, gyms per 10,000 people, budget competitors, major chains, and premium/boutique supply.

Service Gap

Gap signal using low availability of budget gyms, personal training, group classes, tanning, hydromassage, and customer-rating evidence where available.

Preliminary Opportunity Score combines demand fit and service-gap signals, then reduces the score for competition pressure. Treat it as a screening score for shortlist decisions, not a final lease/site decision.

Sources and Citations

Data used in this dashboard

Cite in report
  • Statistics Canada 2021 Census ProfileDemographics, population, density, age, income, employment, dwellings, and renter indicators.
  • Statistics Canada boundary/geography filesUsed to create project-defined market zones and approximate zone coverage.
  • Fit4Less locations and Planet Fitness Ontario clubsUsed where available for chain locations and brand/amenity interpretation.
  • OpenStreetMap / NominatimUsed for expanded gym-place search, addresses, coordinates, and mapping support.
  • SerpApi / Google Maps-style review auditUsed to populate ratings, review counts, and location-match checks where the API result was a strong or likely match.
  • Manual verification requiredBefore final business claims, verify competitor list, amenities, ratings, reviews, and current hours with Google Maps and official gym websites.

AI Use Statement

Required transparency note

Include in submission

AI assistance was used to help design the project framework, structure datasets, generate dashboard code, draft interpretation logic, and refine methodology wording. The final analysis, source verification, and business interpretation should be reviewed by the student before submission.

Example prompt disclosure: “Help me create a gym location analytics dashboard for Ontario market zones using demographic and competitor variables, with clear methodology, limitations, and AI-use acknowledgement.”
